articles.title: French Senate blocks new crypto tax and wallet list critics called a kidnapping risk
articles.snippet: The government opposed the measures citing existing EU data-sharing rules and non-legal tender status, leaving the 2027 budget open.

articles.title: French Senate rejects 100K euro crypto wallet disclosure requirement
articles.snippet: Senators also rejected stablecoin-swap and crypto exit-tax proposals, while the 2027 budget remains under parliamentary consideration.

articles.title: China's Google Just Released Its Fast New AI Model for Free
articles.snippet: Baidu has released the weights of its new high-speed reasoning model, giving developers a commercially usable alternative to proprietary AI services from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic

articles.title: OpenAI’s Changes to ChatGPT Could Drastically Cut Usage Limits for Paying Subscribers
articles.snippet: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT’s Chat and Work modes, forcing advanced conversations to compete with coding tasks for usage and leaving paying subscribers wondering how much AI they will actually get.

articles.title: French Senate Rejects Plan to Make Crypto Holders Declare Self-Custody Wallets
articles.snippet: Holders had warned that reporting wallets worth over €100,000 could expose them to risk in a country hit by a wave of crypto kidnappings.
